description: S458 slice 2 (position 3): a refined `const` is judged like a refined `let`. `const link: string(url) = v` with v = "javascript:alert(1)" throws E-CONTRACT-001-RT before `link` binds, so @shown keeps the https value from the first click. Before S458 the `const` emitter ignored the check the type stage computed — every `const` refinement, at any depth, was unchecked.
rationale: §53.2.2 "variable declaration: let x: number(...) = expr" — `const` is a variable declaration; §53.4.3(1) a raw function value is the boundary zone; §53.4.5.
